proIde.profileManagedTooltip: Pinned built-ins, the Cognia broker, and signed generated proxies. Agent drive, chat context, and plugin IDE capabilities all need this profile.
proIde.profileNativeTooltip: Your Open VSX extensions, in a separate process with its own settings and extension directory. It never receives Cognia broker credentials, so agent drive and plugin IDE capabilities are unavailable here.
proIde.profileSwitchRestarts: Switching profile starts a separate VS Code. Open editors and terminals stay in the other profile.
proIde.remoteWorkbenchLabel: Editor signals stay on the host
proIde.remoteWorkbenchTooltip: You are driving a remote host, and the workbench above is that host's. Everything the app sends now reaches it: the agent opens, diffs and saves files there, and the workbench follows the app's colours and language. What does not come back is the reverse direction. The companion extension reports editor changes as events on the host process, and events are not part of the remote command surface, so "Add to Chat", the context-menu actions and the active-editor signal only work on a workbench this machine owns.
proIde.revokedToMonaco: Switched back to Monaco — the VS Code pane was taken by another editor or stopped.
proIde.supportCheckFailed: Couldn't check Pro IDE availability. Try again after reconnecting to the desktop host.
proIde.unsupportedDesc: code-server has no build for your operating system. Use your local VS Code instead.

reason.framing-refused: The workbench declined to be embedded on this page. It is running and reachable, so open it in its own tab instead.
reason.needs-host-browser: The workbench is running on the host, but this browser cannot reach it. It answers on a loopback port on that machine, and the only route across the network authenticates the device on every request, which an embedded frame cannot do. Open it from the desktop app on that machine, or from a browser running on the host.
reason.not-running: No workbench is running for this workspace yet.
